verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never publishes an operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout for the UTR/UTS online flow. The only time-related statement is that an unfinished registration can be resumed for up to one year. That is a save-and-resume retention window, an adjacent feature rather than an up-front disclosure of availability hours or session limits. The application host itself could not be probed, so no further evidence exists either way.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
